title: Tech Note: Using the Execute Command

historical_commentary.text: The EXECUTE command in 4D had significant limitations — single-line expressions only, no control flow keywords. This note's workaround (seven parsing methods) shows the ingenuity required in the v6 era. Modern 4D provides Formula objects and the EXECUTE METHOD command, as well as more flexible dynamic code execution capabilities that make such elaborate workarounds unnecessary.
